scope: Measured orchard outcomes constrain climate response functions; location of a study never increases map score.

protocol.scoreBlindAudit: This audit did not open orchard-validation.json or sample new model scores. Outcomes and split are based on source evidence and previous development use.
protocol.unit: One study/geographic cluster, not each cultivar, treatment, tree, nearby plot or year
protocol.trainingRule: Fit only globally available physical climate/hazard features in development data; no orchard radius, country ID or nearest-study bonus. Freeze/station calibration uses station climate data, not orchard-presence labels.
protocol.positiveCheck: Repeated measured harvests must remain compatible with production under the documented cultivar/water/management regime. A strong false exclusion is score<40; this threshold is a screen policy, not an observed yield-probability calibration target.
protocol.failureCheck: Repeated documented nonflowering must not be described as dependable prime production. Check the entire Texas study as one held-out challenge, not two independent negatives.
protocol.annualReliability: No per-location probability target is invented. Positive potential, alternate bearing, observed annual series, young-tree effects and climate damage are distinct outcomes.
protocol.holdoutReporting: Report every held-out cluster and contradiction. If held-out data are used to revise a component, declare them development and do not report them as untouched validation.
